suggested_fix: No fix required. The insertion into the reorder list uses a raw list_head cursor (pos) with list_for_each_prev, so when the loop finishes without a break, pos correctly equals the list head and list_add inserts at the front. This avoids the earlier bug where a list_for_each_entry_prev cursor was used after the loop and pointed to a bogus entry computed from the list head. The list is changed under reorder->lock, and smp_mb() pairs correctly with padata_reorder.
